WITH per_synset AS (
  SELECT
    s.wordid,
    s.synsetid,
    w.word,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    syn.domainid,
    syn.posid
  FROM senses AS s
  JOIN words AS w ON w.wordid = s.wordid
  JOIN synsets AS syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid, w.word, syn.domainid, syn.posid
),
word_stats AS (
  SELECT
    wordid,
    word,
    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM per_synset
  GROUP BY wordid, word
  HAVING total_synsets >= 2
    AND distinct_domains >= 2
    AND total_senses >= 2
),
top AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT
      p.wordid,
      p.synsetid,
      p.cnt,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.wordid ORDER BY p.cnt DESC, p.synsetid ASC) AS rn
    FROM per_synset AS p
    JOIN word_stats AS ws ON ws.wordid = p.wordid
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ws.wordid AS word_id,
  ws.word AS word,
  ws.total_synsets,
  ws.total_senses,
  ws.distinct_domains,
  ws.distinct_posids,
  t.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  t.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM word_stats AS ws
JOIN top AS t ON t.wordid = ws.wordid
ORDER BY
  ws.total_senses DESC,
  ws.total_synsets DESC,
  ws.distinct_domains DESC,
  ws.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
